title: Abnormal Procedures — Cargo Compartment Smoke

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Flight crew procedure for a cargo compartment smoke warning, covering the immediate actions, the extinguishing sequence and the decision to divert, with the guidance on warnings that follow a wet loading.

sections.purpose: This entry gives the flight crew procedure for a cargo compartment smoke warning, from the first indication through the extinguishing sequence to the landing decision.
sections.description: A smoke warning in a cargo compartment is annunciated on the flight deck with an aural alert and the affected compartment named. The aeroplane arms the extinguishing system for that compartment and inhibits the associated ventilation so that the agent is retained. The crew cannot see into the compartment and has no means of confirming the warning in flight, so the procedure treats every warning as genuine. Where the warning follows loading in heavy rain or wet snow, operators may have observed warnings that were later found to have no source; that history does not change the crew action. The system holds sufficient agent for an initial discharge and a metered flow for the published period, which sets the time available to reach an aerodrome.
sections.crew_procedure: On SMOKE FWD CARGO or SMOKE AFT CARGO, don oxygen masks if smoke is also present in the cabin, then carry out the ECAM actions. Discharge the agent for the affected compartment as directed. Descend and divert to the nearest suitable aerodrome, planning the landing inside the published agent duration. Do not open the affected compartment on the ground until the fire service is in position. Advise the cabin crew and expect no further indication from the compartment once the ventilation is inhibited.
sections.limitation_note: The agent duration published in the performance section is the limiting factor for the diversion decision and must be applied from the time of the first discharge, not from the time of the warning.

type_data.crew_action: ECAM actions, agent discharge, descend and divert within the published agent duration.
